sources.name: Hamilton Public Library
sources.notes: Communico feed, ~2000 events per quarter across all branches. Carries the YWCA immigration tables and employment workshops. Age field is used to filter out children's programming.

sources.name: McMaster Student Success Centre
sources.notes: Custom WordPress card-grid theme, no REST feed. All events render into one page load (no working pagination needed), scraped with a regex parser (kind mcmaster_cards). Long date ranges (e.g. year-round webinar series) are scored on their listed start date.

sources.name: Mohawk College
sources.notes: Drupal Views event-list teaser markup, no REST feed. Scraped with a regex parser (kind mohawk_drupal), paginated via ?page=N. Start/end times come as ISO UTC in the <time datetime> attribute.

sources.name: YMCA Hamilton Immigrant Services
sources.notes: That page is program descriptions only, no dated events listing. Needs the actual events/calendar URL found before a parser can be built.

sources.name: City of Hamilton events
sources.notes: Festivals and civic events; entered by hand until a feed is confirmed.

sources.name: Hamilton Immigration Partnership Council
sources.notes: Curated one-off events page (currently just the annual Newcomer Day), submitted by partner orgs — no feed, no plugin. Best handled as manual entry, not a scraper target.

sources.name: iLink Students
sources.notes: Already the source of several published Hamilton events (Bible study, English conversation groups).

sources.name: Blessings Christian Church
sources.notes: Runs the international student friendship dinners already on the site.

sources.name: Hope Church Hamilton
sources.notes: Sunday service bus route for students already published on the site.

sources.name: West Highland Church
sources.notes: Runs on the Nucleus church platform. Has a calendar page but no JSON/ICS feed found; needs a custom scraper or hand entry.

sources.name: Tourism Hamilton
sources.notes: Custom PHP events system, no REST/JSON feed found. Needs a custom scraper.

sources.name: Hamilton Chamber of Business Events
sources.notes: WordPress, but the Events Calendar REST route 404s (likely disabled). Per-event .ics export exists; no bulk feed. Needs a scraper or hand entry.

sources.name: Invest in Hamilton Events
sources.notes: The Events Calendar REST feed works via ?rest_route= (pretty permalinks are off). Confirmed live with real workshop events.

sources.name: James North Baptist Church
sources.notes: Ascend for Churches (Tithe.ly) platform. Has a calendar with an .ics subscribe link but no JSON feed found; needs a custom scraper or hand entry.

sources.name: Mission Baptist Hamilton Events
sources.notes: Custom Django site, static HTML events, no feed found. Needs a scraper or hand entry.

sources.name: Ticketmaster Hamilton
sources.notes: No public feed, but the Next.js page ships the full event list pre-rendered in __NEXT_DATA__ (initialReduxState.api.queries.cityEvents...data.events), paginated with ?page=N. No price field is exposed, so cost is set to the literal string 'Paid' (an empty string scores as free in build_board.py's scorer - learned the hard way) so ticketed shows don't get a false free-cost credit.
